name: Mooney M-18 Mite
summary: Tiny single-seat low-wing built for budget personal flying after the war; remarkable for its retractable tricycle gear. 283 were built before production ended in 1954.

wings: Low cantilever wing with no struts
Short, compact wing, noticeably smaller than a two-seat trainer's
engines: Single small 65 hp flat-four in a compact cowl
fuselage: Single-seat cockpit under a small canopy
Retractable tricycle gear, wheels folded away in flight

tellTales: Tiny single-seat low-wing with retractable tricycle gear
Bantam-sized airframe with a very small cowl and short wing
Clean belly in flight with the wheels folded away

confusedWith.howToTell: The M20 is a full four-seat cabin airplane; the Mite is a tiny single-seater less than half its size.
The Culver V is a two-seat cabin aircraft with upward-bent outer wing panels; the Mite is a much smaller single-seater.
The Cadet is a two-seat tailwheel low-wing; the Mite sits on retractable tricycle gear and has one seat.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
